note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, seventeen single-member divisions; nominations received on Tuesday 16 May 1961. There were no contests ('No contests in Kilkeel'), so no poll was held; filed on 1 June 1961, the Co. Down county and rural polling day that year. No party labels are printed in the list. Sole nomination; no contest in the district. New member, replacing Michael J. Hardy. Returned unopposed.
